title: How to Edit Default Character Sprite Offsets in RPG Maker MV?

posts.author: fabula-requiei
fabula-requiei
posts.body:
... I found it.
If anyone else need it you need to:
in rpg_objects find
Game_CharacterBase.prototype.shiftY = function() {
return this.isObjectCharacter() ? 0 : 6;
you have to change that 6 to 0
I was a bit stressed out and now a bit shame about posting it and now have found it ...but if anyone know any issue about doing this it will help a lot too!

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: Yeah the default bush tile logic is a bit harsh. The shift value is also hard coded and is only good for average sized resources.
